verdict.rationale: vLLM's first-party docs include a dedicated CLI reference page. It documents commands that start the OpenAI-compatible API server, run an interactive session that prints TTFT and throughput stats, and run latency and throughput benchmarks. The docs also cite CLI flags such as --trust-remote-code for online serving. Missing for 10: detailed command coverage beyond brief snippets, evidence of AI-native or agent-friendly CLI features (e.g. machine-readable output), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
